title: HSK 1.5 · 工作, 电话, 地方, 上班, 吃饭
focus: 工作 · 事 · 前 · 爱 · 地 · 跟 · 喜欢 · 吃 · 谁 · 新 · 打 · 快 · 比 · 话 · 月 · 车 · 开 · 地方 · 电话 · 路 · 早 · 电影 · 动 · 电视 · 说话 · 电脑 · 电 · 早上 · 打开 · 打电话 · 班 · 吃饭 · 动作 · 上班 · 饭 · 路上 · 地点 · 车上 · 地上
body:
Daily life: work, meals, phones and screens. 电 (electric) makes four modern words, and 打, 地 and 上 build most of the rest.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 电 | diàn | electric; lightning | 电话, 电影, 电视, 电脑 |
| 打 | dǎ | hit; do (扌 + 丁 dīng) | 打开, 打电话 |
| 地 | dì / de | ground, place (土 + 也) | 地方, 地点, 地上 |
| 上 | shàng / shang | on; go to | 上班, 路上, 车上, 地上 |
| 作 | zuò | do, make | 工作, 动作 |
| 话 | huà | speech (讠 + 舌 tongue) | 电话, 说话 |
| 班 | bān | shift, class | 上班 |
| 车 | chē | vehicle | 车上 |

## Watch out

- 地 is dì (ground) in 地方, but toneless de when it links an adverb to a verb (慢慢地走).
- 车 (vehicle) vs 东 (dōng, east): similar top, different bottoms.
- 月 on the left often means body/flesh, not moon: 脑 (brain).

cards.Example: 你做什么工作? nǐ zuò shénme gōngzuò: What do you do for work?
cards.Notes: 工 work (a tool) + 作 do, make (亻 + 乍 zhà) = to work

cards.Example: 有事吗? yǒu shì ma: Anything up?
cards.Notes: One long vertical through 一, 口 and a hand ⺕; 8 strokes

cards.Example: 前面有人。 qiánmiàn yǒu rén: There's someone ahead.
cards.Notes: Top 丷 + 一, then 月 with 刂 on the right. 前 vs 煎 (jiān, fry)

cards.Example: 我爱你。 wǒ ài nǐ: I love you.
cards.Notes: 爫 hand + 冖 cover + 友 friend; traditional 愛 has 心 heart in the middle

cards.Example: 地上有水。 dìshang yǒu shuǐ: There's water on the floor.
cards.Notes: 土 earth + 也; dì = ground, de links adverbs to verbs. 地 vs 他 vs 她

cards.Example: 跟我来。 gēn wǒ lái: Come with me.
cards.Notes: 𧾷 foot + 艮 gēn for the sound: heel, follow, so 'with'

cards.Example: 她喜欢吃米饭。 tā xǐhuan chī mǐfàn: She likes rice.
cards.Notes: 欢 = 又 + 欠 (open mouth); 喜 has two 口 hidden inside

cards.Example: 你吃了吗? nǐ chī le ma: Have you eaten?
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 乞 qǐ

cards.Example: 他是谁? tā shì shéi: Who's he?
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 隹 (short-tailed bird). Also pronounced shuí

cards.Example: 这是新的。 zhè shì xīn de: This is new.
cards.Notes: Left: 立 + 木 (wood), right: 斤 axe: freshly cut wood = new

cards.Example: 别打他! bié dǎ tā: Don't hit him!
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 丁 dīng (nail) for the sound

cards.Example: 快来! kuài lái: Come quick!
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 夬; the same right side gives the sound in 块 kuài and 筷 kuài

cards.Example: 他比我高。 tā bǐ wǒ gāo: He's taller than me.
cards.Notes: Two people side by side: compare. 比 vs 北 (běi, north)

cards.Example: 我有话要说。 wǒ yǒu huà yào shuō: I have something to say.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 舌 tongue

cards.Example: 我下个月去。 wǒ xià ge yuè qù: I'm going next month.
cards.Notes: Picture of a crescent moon. As a left radical it usually means flesh (脑, 脸)

cards.Example: 我的车在那里。 wǒ de chē zài nàlǐ: My car is over there.
cards.Notes: Simplified picture of a cart (車). 车 vs 东 (dōng, east)

cards.Meaning: to open; to drive; to turn on
cards.Example: 开门! kāi mén: Open the door!
cards.Notes: Two hands lifting a bar; traditional 開 has 门 door around it

cards.Example: 这个地方很好。 zhège dìfang hěn hǎo: This place is nice.
cards.Notes: 地 ground + 方 square, direction = a spot: place

cards.Example: 你的电话! nǐ de diànhuà: Phone for you!
cards.Notes: 电 electric + 话 speech = telephone

cards.Example: 这条路很长。 zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng: This road is long.
cards.Notes: 𧾷 foot + 各 gè (sound): where feet go

cards.Example: 你早! nǐ zǎo: Morning!
cards.Notes: 日 sun on top of 十. 早 vs 旱 (hàn, drought), where 日 sits over 干

cards.Example: 我们去看电影吧。 wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba: Let's go see a movie.
cards.Notes: 电 electric + 影 shadow, image (景 + 彡 rays) = film

cards.Example: 别动! bié dòng: Don't move!
cards.Notes: 云 + 力 strength: force makes it move (traditional 動 = 重 + 力)

cards.Example: 他在看电视。 tā zài kàn diànshì: He's watching TV.
cards.Notes: 电 electric + 视 view (礻 + 见 see) = television

cards.Example: 他不说话。 tā bù shuōhuà: He won't talk.
cards.Notes: Both have 讠 speech; 话 = 讠 + 舌 tongue

cards.Example: 我的电脑坏了。 wǒ de diànnǎo huài le: My computer broke.
cards.Notes: 电 electric + 脑 brain (月 flesh radical) = electric brain

cards.Example: 没电了。 méi diàn le: The battery's dead.
cards.Notes: A box with a lightning tail; traditional 電 has 雨 rain on top

cards.Example: 我早上不吃饭。 wǒ zǎoshang bù chīfàn: I don't eat in the morning.
cards.Notes: 早 = 日 sun over 十: the sun just up; 上 is toneless here

cards.Example: 请打开门。 qǐng dǎkāi mén: Please open the door.
cards.Notes: 打 do + 开 open = open up, turn on

cards.Example: 我给你打电话。 wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà: I'll call you.
cards.Notes: 打 do + 电话 telephone = to phone

cards.Example: 我们是一个班的。 wǒmen shì yí ge bān de: We're in the same class.
cards.Notes: 王 jade + 刂 knife + 王: a knife splitting jade in two, so a group, a shift

cards.Example: 吃饭了! chīfàn le: Time to eat!
cards.Notes: 吃 has 口 mouth; 饭 = 饣 food + 反 fǎn for the sound

cards.Example: 这个动作很难。 zhège dòngzuò hěn nán: This move is hard.
cards.Notes: 动 move + 作 do = a movement

cards.Example: 我九点上班。 wǒ jiǔ diǎn shàngbān: I start work at nine.
cards.Notes: 上 go up to + 班 shift = go on shift: go to work

cards.Example: 饭好了。 fàn hǎo le: Food's ready.
cards.Notes: 饣 food + 反 fǎn for the sound

cards.Example: 我在路上。 wǒ zài lùshang: I'm on my way.
cards.Notes: 路 road + 上 on = on the road

cards.Example: 开会地点在哪里? kāihuì dìdiǎn zài nǎlǐ: Where is the meeting?
cards.Notes: 地 place + 点 point = the exact spot

cards.Meaning: in the car, on the bus
cards.Example: 我在车上。 wǒ zài chēshang: I'm on the bus.
cards.Notes: 车 vehicle + 上 on = on board

cards.Meaning: on the ground, on the floor
cards.Example: 别坐在地上。 bié zuò zài dìshang: Don't sit on the floor.
cards.Notes: 地 ground + 上 on = on the ground
